interpretation: The old seventeen-stream layer is retained but hidden by default; the seven selected mainstems and five constructed tributary paths are independent editable overlays. All labels are illustrative names.
style: Branch paths use thinner three-pass line strokes, principal rivers use wider three-pass strokes and minimal mouth broadening; valley tints are ornamental not land-cover data.
geographic_guards: No known named sea is assigned.
Prior unknown Tangxi outlet and Xire relation remain unknown.
The candidate rivers are mathematical shapes, not evidenced hydrological watersheds.
